subject.title: [Bug]: codex turn watchdogs have inconsistent defer guards and no wall-clock ceiling; attempt-idle aborts long quiet native tool calls

question: Should the Codex app-server harness add an absolute wall-clock turn ceiling while deferring idle watchdogs for active native tool blockers and in-flight turn requests?
rationale: Source evidence supports the bug, but the wall-clock ceiling and request-wide defer rule are liveness-policy choices, and the issue already has protected maintainer and product-decision labels plus an open candidate PR that needs repair and proof.

options.title: Approve repaired PR shape
options.body: Accept the wall-clock ceiling direction, require https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101512 to fix the post-blocker scheduling path and add live proof, then review it for merge.

options.title: Split mechanical fixes
options.body: Land blocker ordering and attempt-idle deferral first, then track the wall-clock ceiling as a narrower timeout-policy follow-up.

options.title: Reject wall-clock ceiling
options.body: Keep the harness idle-timeout-only design and narrow or close the candidate PR to the blocker/attempt-idle pieces only.

recommendation.title: Approve repaired PR shape
recommendation.body: Accept the wall-clock ceiling direction, require https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101512 to fix the post-blocker scheduling path and add live proof, then review it for merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing candidate from recent app-server seam work and merger history for the adjacent native-tool blocker fix.
